ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Question: Calculate the operating frequency of the following oscillator circuit, if \(C_1 = 0.047 \, \mu F\) and \(L_1 = 150 \, mH\), as shown in the figure. The operating frequency is ______kHz.
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows a transistor LC oscillator circuit. On the left side there is a parallel resonant circuit composed of C1 and L1, connected to the transistor input terminal through the coupling capacitor C2; on the right side the transistor and bias resistors R1, R2, collector resistor RC, emitter resistor RE, and bypass capacitor CE can be seen. Reasoning: According to an ideal LC oscillator, the operating frequency is determined by the left-side parallel resonant circuit C1-L1, ignoring the bias, coupling, and bypass elements. Given C1 = 0.047 μF = 0.047 × 10^-6 F, L1 = 150 mH = 0.150 H. The formula is f = 1/(2π√(L1C1)). Substituting gives L1C1 = 0.150 × 0.047 × 10^-6 = 7.05 × 10^-9, √(L1C1) ≈ 8.40 × 10^-5, so f ≈ 1/(2π × 8.40 × 10^-5) ≈ 1895 Hz = 1.895 kHz, approximately 1.9 kHz.
